summary: The unchanged provider-visible unanswered-call projection passes its 13 tests inside native gates on Linux, Intel macOS, and Windows at rebased candidate 1e94aba7e2. Windows tested a synthetic merge with the exact candidate tree. Earlier rule-defect controls remain evidence on their original candidate. Raw-path unfinished work, child/inbox projections, arm64 hosts, and remaining session integration still prevent scope-02 completion.

results.behavior: All 13 unanswered:: cases pass on each host, including every-byte truncations, all leaves at line boundaries, compaction, context edits, message boundaries, malformed messages, duplicate ids, and comparison with transform_messages. The function and all three fixture-definition files are byte-identical to original candidate 32394c11f5. This predicts synthetic provider results; it neither reconstructs raw path history nor proves that an external effect occurred.

Linux and Intel macOS each pass all three native gates; Windows passes Rust checks and native eval fixtures while skipping the unimplemented ConPTY gate. Cargo test totals, including the standalone sandbox harness, are 1578 passed on Linux, 1552 on Intel macOS, and 1476 on Windows, with zero failures and three ignored on each. These are test-case counts, distinct from the command gate counts. The Mac PTY gate internally skips two Linux /proc cases. No Apple Silicon or Windows terminal execution is claimed.

Linux and Intel macOS tested commit 1e94aba7e2ed8f970391f22c8815724a75145031. Windows checkout 0f06650120dfe5f21aab25fe9357db447ef1c31e merged that head into ebd4542114ccb816508d4bac7ba48a4470d52865. GitHub git-commit metadata reports its tree as b10755b6c045a461e323bbbbeb85f5aa17c03e68, equal to the candidate and the Mac checkout. This is a whole-tree equality, not only a source-file comparison.

The two original source mutations still provide the negative-control evidence: omitting the aborted-message exclusion or the user-message closure fails the owning tests on original candidate 32394c11f5, followed by 13 passing restored tests. These controls were not rerun during the host follow-up. The candidate function and fixture files have the same bytes and hashes; original command provenance is retained below.

missingEvidence.reason: This follow-up covers x86_64 only. Intel macOS does not qualify Apple Silicon. Windows ConPTY is unimplemented and skipped; two Mac PTY cases need Linux /proc. These gaps do not contradict the executed pure projection cases, but remain release qualification work.

Group append and selected writer-kill boundaries now have their own scope-03 record, 2026-10-17-session-group-append. A kill inside the append system call, real ENOSPC/EIO, power loss, and the remaining crash matrix are not established by this projection follow-up.
This attempt does not re-audit or port every AgentSession and CLI session case named in the earlier record.
